Image traffic is local ComfyUI or direct .env APIs. OmniRoute is text only. Never OmniRoute images.

B0 is architecture only. No Blender or ComfyUI code until B1.
Test fixture is HIMYM Episode 1 (76 panels, longest V1 script). B1 proves panel 1 only.
